data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 1,776,000 on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. A deterioration of GBP 3,356,000 on fire and other damage to property was partially offset by improvements of GBP 1,275,000 on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 344,000 on reinsurance acceptances.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserves in respect of the 2012 and prior years of account continue to improve and develop satisfactorily, generating a surplus of GBP 6.1 million in 2015.
The only increases of note came from the primary marine employers' liability class, which continued to witness some adverse claims development in the period.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 1.776 million in 2015. This was primarily driven by a deterioration of GBP 3.356 million in the Fire and other damage to property line of business. This adverse development was partially offset by favorable claims development, including improvements of GBP 1.275 million in Marine, aviation and transport and GBP 0.344 million in Reinsurance acceptances. Additionally, reserves for the 2012 and prior years of account generated a surplus of GBP 6.1 million, indicating favorable development for older periods, while the 2013 year of account saw adverse claims development in the primary marine employers' liability class.
